label: all recorded separations
formula: mean of separation_at_pass_forward over eligible player-plays with a recorded value
class_basis: internally consistent, semantics inferred (no authoritative definition recorded for separation_at_pass_forward)
interpretation_label: recorded separation at pass forward, mean over recorded player-plays [yd] — an INTERACTION outcome (receiver, nearest defender, coverage, route, throw timing); NOT pure receiver ability

label: recorded separations with a route label
formula: mean of separation_at_pass_forward over eligible player-plays with a recorded value AND a recorded route_ran
class_basis: internally consistent, semantics inferred (no authoritative definition recorded for separation_at_pass_forward, route_ran)
interpretation_label: same as FO01.S0 restricted to rows with a route label

label: route × alignment adjusted separations (supported cells)
formula: mean over S1 rows in supported route × alignment cells of (separation − cell mean)
class_basis: internally consistent, semantics inferred (no authoritative definition recorded for separation_at_pass_forward, route_ran)
interpretation_label: separation relative to the mean of the recorded route × alignment cell [yd] — removes route mix and NFL role, which are partly properties of the player; context SENSITIVITY

label: targeted only (sensitivity)
formula: mean of separation_at_pass_forward over S0 rows with target = true
class_basis: selected denominator (sensitivity only): the quarterback chooses the target: the plays are selected on the outcome
interpretation_label: separation on targeted plays only — plays selected on the outcome by the quarterback; sensitivity

label: not targeted only (sensitivity)
formula: mean of separation_at_pass_forward over S0 rows with target = false
class_basis: selected denominator (sensitivity only): complement of a selection on the outcome
interpretation_label: separation on non-targeted plays only — complement of a selection on the outcome; sensitivity

label: rows with a recorded tackle statistic
formula: mean of tackle over eligible player-plays with a recorded tackle value
class_basis: credited_only denominator (sensitivity only): the rows exist only when a tackle statistic was credited: non-successes are not observed
interpretation_label: share of credited-statistic rows that are solo tackles — NOT a tackle rate per opportunity

label: credited tackles per tracked snap
formula: sum of (tackle > 0) over ALL eligible player-plays of the athlete / number of those player-plays
class_basis: rejected by the 08A.2 screen: game-split reliability is not assessable, below the floor, or its lower bound is not positive
interpretation_label: credited solo tackles per tracked snap — exposure, NOT tackle success probability

label: credited tackles + assists per tracked snap
formula: sum of (tackle > 0 or assist > 0) over ALL eligible player-plays of the athlete / number of those player-plays
unit: tackles or assists per eligible snap
class_basis: internally consistent, semantics inferred (no authoritative definition recorded for tackle, assist)
interpretation_label: PARTICIPATION-CREDIT rate: credited tackles or assists per tracked snap — NOT tackle success probability; snaps on the field are exposure, not tackle opportunities

label: sack credit per recorded row
formula: mean of sack (0, 0.5, 1) over eligible player-plays with a recorded sack value
class_basis: internally consistent, semantics inferred (no authoritative definition recorded for sack)
interpretation_label: sack credit per recorded pass-defence row — NOT a pass-rush win rate; that the player rushed the passer is not recorded

label: sack credit per recorded row without a coverage assignment
formula: mean of sack over K0 rows with coverage_assignment = NO_ASSIGNMENT
class_basis: inferred denominator (sensitivity only): NO_ASSIGNMENT is read as 'rushed the passer': an inference about the assignment
interpretation_label: sack credit per row without a coverage assignment — NO_ASSIGNMENT is NOT verified pass rushing; sensitivity

label: sack credit per tracked snap
formula: sum of sack over ALL eligible player-plays of the athlete / number of those player-plays
class_basis: internally consistent, semantics inferred (no authoritative definition recorded for sack)
interpretation_label: sack credit per tracked snap (run plays in the denominator) — NOT a pass-rush win rate; sensitivity
